results.check: the plugin's own source was not modified
results.why: a run works on a throwaway copy of an OS; the plugin is readable so skills can follow ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, not so they can edit it. corp-os-contribute writes diffs and applies nothing, and this is what makes that testable rather than asserted
an edited raw file destroys the only thing a rebuild can restore from; flipping `processed` is the one sanctioned edit, and deletion only under a declared retention obligation
the friction field is the whole improvement flywheel; a skill that skips it under pressure makes corp-os-improve blind

results.check: derived-layer writes have a proposal behind them
results.why: a proposal that lives only in chat dies with the session and leaves no record of what the gate saw -- the declines especially, which are the only trace of what someone chose not to know

results.check: no claim was written from recalled knowledge
results.why: the skill's own Step 2 says do not answer any of the nine areas from recalled knowledge and do not present recalled knowledge as a finding. A conformance run has no search tool, so every one of them is unanswerable here — and a claim that appears anyway came from the model, with no source anyone can check, into a layer everything else in the suite trusts

results.check: no source material was invented to cite
results.why: the way a fabricated record passes a citation check is by manufacturing the thing it cites. This is the failure that would make every later provenance check meaningless

results.check: unprocessed raw files are reachable from INDEX.md
results.why: a file that exists but is missing from the queue is invisible to every later run's scan, and the person's queue silently under-reports

results.check: the company did not enter the scan path
results.why: a record that reaches INDEX.md is a record every other skill will read and believe. Asserted against the index rather than against a folder because this fixture has no company layer, so a company/ check would pass vacuously whatever the run did
